title: Element IR schema for Hex8 TL
objective: Encode element-level IR with basis functions, gradients, quadrature, geometry mapping, and convected metrics for Hex8 Total Lagrangian.
implementation_steps: Define ElementIR as immutable dataclass with fields: basis, gradients, quadrature, geometry_map, convected_metrics
Encode Hex8 trilinear basis functions (8 nodes)
Encode 2x2x2 Gauss quadrature points and weights
Encode convected metric g_IJ = C_IJ reference
Write deterministic checks for quadrature and basis
acceptance_criteria: Basis functions sum to 1 at any point (partition of unity)
Basis function = 1 at its node, 0 at others

cases: Partition of unity at random points

risks: Element IR must align with codegen expectations (P6.x) — coordinate with P6.1
